description: Canonical name of the originating dataset.
missing_value_policy: Required; do not infer. Use not_reported only if the source itself cannot be identified.
source_mapping_notes: Expected values for planned imports: siRNAEfficacyDB or CMsiRNAdb. Never use this field to imply comparability across sources.

description: Record identifier exactly as assigned by the originating dataset.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no stable record-level identifier is supplied.
source_mapping_notes: Do not replace with a locally generated identifier.

description: Resolvable URL to the source dataset record download page or source record when available.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no resolvable URL is supplied.
source_mapping_notes: Dataset-level URL is acceptable only when a record-level URL is unavailable.

description: Lossless serialized representation of the original source row or record.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported only when the raw record cannot be retained.
source_mapping_notes: Preserves source-specific fields and original notation that are not represented by the unified columns.

description: Name or relative path of the immutable downloaded source file from which the record was parsed.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when unavailable.
source_mapping_notes: Supports reproducibility without replacing the original raw file.

description: Target gene identifier or symbol exactly as reported by the source.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when the source does not report a target gene.
source_mapping_notes: Do not resolve aliases or infer identifiers during initial ingestion; retain any later mapping in a separate curation layer.

description: Unmodified or raw sense strand sequence in the source-reported orientation.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no sense strand is supplied.
source_mapping_notes: Do not derive a complementary strand. Preserve modified-sequence notation in source_raw_record and chemical_modification_reported.

description: Unmodified or raw antisense strand sequence in the source-reported orientation.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no antisense strand is supplied.
source_mapping_notes: Do not derive a complementary strand. Preserve modified-sequence notation in source_raw_record and chemical_modification_reported.

description: Controlled source-aware chemistry summary when an explicit mapping has been documented.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when chemistry is absent or has not been mapped.
source_mapping_notes: This field may retain a source-specific category; it must not be populated as unmodified unless the source explicitly states that.

description: Verbatim source-reported chemical modification text or encoding.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when the source does not report chemistry.
source_mapping_notes: For CMsiRNAdb retain the reported modification sequence or annotation exactly; never reconstruct it from sequence alone.

description: Verbatim source-reported nucleotide or backbone modification positions.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when positions are absent.
source_mapping_notes: Do not infer positions from a chemistry label or convert position conventions without a documented parser.

description: Reported numerical activity measurement without rescaling or cross-source transformation.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no numeric value is reported.
source_mapping_notes: Examples may include inhibition rate or knockdown percentage. A number from one source is not automatically comparable with a number from another.

description: Unit or scale associated with activity_value.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when the source does not state a unit or scale.
source_mapping_notes: Retain source wording such as percent or relative expression; do not assign a unit based on expected value range.

description: Source-reported activity endpoint definition.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when endpoint definition is absent.
source_mapping_notes: Examples include inhibition rate or gene-expression knockdown. Do not collapse endpoints into one label without a documented rule.

description: Harmonized assay category only when an explicit source-to-category mapping exists.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no assay method is reported or mapped.
source_mapping_notes: Do not populate from an assumed patent or database workflow.

description: Verbatim source-reported assay or readout method.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when the source does not report it.
source_mapping_notes: Retain original terminology so future mappings remain auditable.

description: Source-reported named cell line.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no cell line is reported.
source_mapping_notes: Do not derive a cell line from cell type.

description: Source-reported cell or tissue type when distinct from a named cell line.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no cell type is reported.
source_mapping_notes: A source may populate cell_type while cell_line remains not_reported.

description: Reported siRNA concentration value without unit conversion.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when absent or not safely parsed.
source_mapping_notes: Retain the original source representation in source_raw_record when a numeric value cannot be separated from its unit.

description: Source-reported concentration unit.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when absent or not safely separable.
source_mapping_notes: Do not infer nM or other units from convention.

description: Reported treatment or incubation duration without unit conversion.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when absent or not safely parsed.
source_mapping_notes: Retain the original source representation in source_raw_record when a numeric value cannot be separated from its unit.

description: Source-reported treatment or incubation time unit.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when absent or not safely separable.
source_mapping_notes: Do not infer hours or days from assay convention.

description: Source-reported publication citation DOI PMID patent identifier or other reference.
missing_value_policy: Use not_reported when no reference is supplied.
source_mapping_notes: For CMsiRNAdb retain patent identifiers; for siRNAEfficacyDB retain the supplied study reference when available.
